whatsappMessage:

I noticed your gym has strong 4.5★ reviews on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://fitness24gym-demo.arclane.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Fitness 24 Gym, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your core fitness programs right opposite AN College on Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain.
